test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an eco-friendly practice?

options.text: Use of chemical fertilizers to increase crop productivity
Disposing waste plastics by dumping in pits under soil
Disposal of biodegradable wastes in ponds
Disposing dry leaves in pits under soil

solution:
The correct answer is __**Disposing of dry leaves in pits under the soil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eco-friendly practices** are actions that minimize harm to the environment.
 
• **They aim to **preserve natural resources, reduce pollution, and protect ecosystems.
 
• **It has a positive impact.**
 
 
• Dry leaves are **biodegradable and can decompose naturally **into organic matter.
 
• This **organic matter can improve soil quality by increasing** its nutrient content and water-holding capacity.
 
• Burying them in pits allows for a slower decomposition process, which can provide nutrients to the soil over a longer period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Use of chemical fertilizers to increase crop productivity**

 
 
• **Chemical fertilizers can pollute water source**s, harm soil microorganisms, and contribute to air pollution.
 
• They can also lead to eutrophication, which is the excessive growth of algae in water bodies.
 
 
 
• ** Disposing of waste plastics by dumping in pits under the soi**l
 
 
• **Plastics are not biodegradable and can take hundreds of years to decompose.**
 
• Burying them in pits can contaminate the soil and harm wildlife that may mistake them for food.
 
 
 
• **Disposal of biodegradable wastes in ponds**
 
 
• While biodegradable wastes will eventually decompose, they can still pollute water bodies.
 
• As they decompose, they can consume oxygen, leading to the death of aquatic organisms.
